summary:
## Standing operator rules
Every sandbox third-party credential must use the ledgerly_sbx prefix and be referenced through settings/vendor_sbx.toml rather than an environment variable.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.

Integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

## Current objective
Fix the webhook signature verification failure in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`; customers receive 400s. Invoice pagination is superseded/paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Contexts: `prod-us-east-1`, `prod-eu-west-1`, `prod-ap-south-1`; namespace: `payments`; image: `registry.acme.io/payments-api:2.8.0-rc.3`; CI pool: `ci-runner-arm64`; files: `ledgerly/cli.py`, `ledgerly/workers/billing_worker.py`, `ledgerly/workers/usage_consumer.py`, `tests/test_cli.py`, `tests/test_commands.py`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Disabling idempotency middleware caused duplicate staging invoices. Removing pending events before `record_usage_event()` failed retry retention. Sharing incoming batches through `extend(batch)` preserved charged events.

## Plan and progress
Worker isolation, memory validation, canary rollout, and CLI filter refactor are done; full suite passed 118 tests with 7 skipped, and CLI tests passed. Webhook fix and verification remain pending. Next pending command: none specified.
